summary: Trekor Metals filed a 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 earnings press release dated November 4, 2026. The report disclosed Adjusted EBITDA of $164 million, cash flow from operations of $122 million, and revenue of $342 million from consolidated sales of 37.4 million pounds of copper and 358 thousand pounds of molybdenum. Net income was $34 million ($0.09 per share) and adjusted net income was $55 million ($0.15 per share). Management cited record quarterly results and provided operational updates on the Gibraltar mine and Florence Copper ramp-up. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
